# The Fashion Xpress

> The Fashion Xpress is a premium home fashion visit service. Our Fashion Executives bring designer outfits directly to your doorstep — try them, buy what you love.

## About

The Fashion Xpress offers personalised home fashion consultations across India. Customers book a visit, choose their preferred styles and sizes, and a trained Fashion Executive arrives with a curated selection of garments for trial.

## Services

- [Book a Home Visit](https://www.thefashionxpress.com/book-visit): Schedule a personal fashion consultation at your home
- [Browse Products](https://www.thefashionxpress.com/products): Explore our curated collection of designer dresses and outfits
- [How It Works](https://www.thefashionxpress.com/how-it-works): Learn about our home visit process
- [Partner With Us](https://www.thefashionxpress.com/partner): Become a merchant or fashion executive partner
- [FAQ](https://www.thefashionxpress.com/faq): Frequently asked questions
